name: Azalea Gym & Leader Kurt
summary: Step into Azalea Gym through its reopened mahogany doors. Navigate the spider-web pulley platforms and face Kurt's junior entomologists before confronting the artisan himself in a 5 vs 5 duel. Overthrow his defensive Blissey/Shuckle core to secure the Hive Badge, unlocking Kurt's specialized Apriball crafting and exclusive vanity gear.
